title: Killers Beware
description: A mod based on the game Dead by Daylight, designed to add the many weapons, objects, and perks the game offers.
body:
Killers Beware is based on the game Dead By Daylight. (I, nor this mod, are affiliated with Behavior Interative or their partners.)

This mod aims to add many of Dead By Daylight's mechanics into the game. Such as, weapons, abilities, perks, objects, etc.

Additions :
Killer Perks -=- Players can equip the frightening perks of Killers. The perk equip menu can be opened by pressing **P**.

Killer Weapons -=- Players have access to the arsenal of Killer weapons and tools, such as the Huntress' Throwing Hatchets or the Wraith's Bell.

Useful Blocks -=- Lockers can be crafted. When interacted with, they grant a few Throwing Hatchets.
